text_en: To the leader. A Psalm of David.
In your strength the king rejoices, O Lord , and in your help how greatly he exults!
text_cn: 上主，君王因你的威能而欣喜， 因你的救助狂欢而快乐无比。

text_en: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah
text_cn: 你满全了他心中的渴想， 没有拒绝他口中的盼望。 （休止）

text_en: For you meet him with rich blessings; you set a crown of fine gold on his head.
text_cn: 因为你已赐给了他超卓的福宠， 且以纯金的冠冕加在他的头顶；

text_en: He asked you for life; you gave it to him— length of days forever and ever.
text_cn: 他虽只向你乞求确保性命， 你却赐他万世无疆的长生。

text_en: His glory is great through your help; splendor and majesty you bestow on him.
text_cn: 你协助他获得了伟大的光荣， 你加给他无比的荣耀与尊崇；

text_en: You bestow on him blessings forever; you make him glad with the joy of your presence.
text_cn: 你使他成了万世的福源， 使他在你面前踊跃喜欢。

text_en: For the king trusts in the Lord , and through the steadfast love of the Most High he shall not be moved.
text_cn: 君王既已全心对上主信赖， 凭至高者的慈爱不再移改。

text_en: Your hand will find out all your enemies; your right hand will find out those who hate you.
text_cn: 愿你的手将你的一切仇敌搜罗， 愿你的右手将憎恨你的人捕捉！

text_en: You will make them like a fiery furnace when you appear. The Lord will swallow them up in his wrath, and fire will consume them.
text_cn: 当你显示你尊容的时候， 处置他们有如放在火炉； 愿上主以震怒消灭他们， 让火焰也尽情吞灭他们！

text_en: You will destroy their offspring from the earth, and their children from among humankind.
text_cn: 愿你从地上灭尽他们的子女， 使他们的后裔全绝迹于人世！

text_en: If they plan evil against you, if they devise mischief, they will not succeed.
text_cn: 他们虽为陷害你而设计， 策划的阴谋却无济于事；

text_en: For you will put them to flight; you will aim at their faces with your bows.
text_cn: 因为你朝他们张弓搭箭， 已使他们吓得转身逃窜。

text_en: Be exalted, O Lord , in your strength! We will sing and praise your power.
text_cn: 上主，请起来，显示你的英勇， 让我们歌颂称扬你的威能。
